contexts.text: The phantasies which they infuse, and the cupidities with which they inflame man, are like inundations and exhalations thence.
There exhaled from them the sphere of a cadaverous stink.
This sphere is such because it exhales from every single thing in him.
From those who have lived in hatred and revenge, there exhale such spheres as cause a swoon and excite vomiting.
This sphere exhaled for some days wherever he went.
The exhalation of Hell is unable to penetrate to Heaven.
An as it were corporeal sphere exhaled from him.
The misty and darksome sphere which exhales from the evils and falsities of those who are in Hell, appears like a mountain or rock under which they are hidden.
As with the fragrance exhaled from flowers...
There is a sphere exhaled from man's interiors which Spirits perceive...
When Hell is opened, and the exhalation thence reaches good Spirits, they are seized with horror and anxiety...
Compared to the nauseous stink which exhales from the stomach. HH 488:4.
The spiritual sphere with a man or Spirit is an exhalation flowing out from the life of his loves.
This is manifest from the sphere that exhales from such from afar. AC 7454:3.

That a man is altogether as his love... is manifest from the Angels, ... who when seen appear as forms of love. The very love not only shines forth from them, but also exhales, so that you would say that they are nothing but loves.
Damnation is felt through the stench that exhales from them...
They are exhalations from their life.
Falsities and evils are exhalations from the Hells.
Spheres proceed from every angelic Society in Heaven, and from every Angel in a Society; these spheres exhale from the life of the affections of truth and good of each one...
They who are in Hell are in externals and not in internals; there also exhale from their externals evils and falsities thence which appear around them like smoke from a furnace.
Through those caverns are exhaled nauseous and fetid stenches...
From every Hell there exhales a sphere of the rapidities in which they are who are there.
When they are open, there exhales thence either as it were fire...
Many Hells communicate with each other by means of exhalations...
Each thing is encompassed with something like that which is within it, and this is continually exhaled from it.
From Hell there is continually exhaled evil and falsity; and from Heaven there is continually exhaled good and truth...
According to these spheres exhaled from their affections through their thoughts...
From his body there exhaled a stinking and unclean heat.
In the Spiritual World there is exhaled from everyone the sphere of his love.
Sympathies and antipathies are nothing but exhalations of affections from minds.
In the other life, delights are... as it were their exhalations.
That thought is perceived by Spirits like an exhalation.
That mist is an exhalation from them.
An exhalation from deep Hells exhaled from him while he was speaking.
The exhalation from this Hell, when it is opened, is such, that it infects those who encounter it... for it excites their interior evils.
Many spheres produce an effect like that from exhalations.
To cause his soul to exhale () = to empty out the spiritual life.
There arises an exhalation thence, and its contagion infects those who walk over it.
That their Hell is such, is evident from the exhalations thence, which are profaned truths and goods...
